author: Zephyr I
title: Std-width nodil — late time injection after pooling (BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: Remove the time channel from the CNN and append a scalar time feature after attention pooling. Tests whether avoiding convolution of non-spatial time improves performance under the std-width nodil PG baseline.
